risk_if_not_implemented: Without Non-Privileged Access for Non-Security Functions, users, services and processes may obtain or retain access beyond authorized need, enabling misuse or escalation. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Excessive or Unauthorized Privilege (R-AC-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) to restrict access to individuals assigned specific roles with legitimate business needs.
compensating_control_1.justification: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) (IAC-06) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Non-Privileged Access for Non-Security Functions (IAC-30.3) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Periodic Review of Individual & Service Account Privileges
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to periodically-review the privileges assigned to individuals and service accounts to validate the need for such privileges and reassign or remove unnecessary privileges, as necessary.
compensating_control_2.justification: Periodic Review of Individual & Service Account Privileges (IAC-12) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Non-Privileged Access for Non-Security Functions (IAC-30.3) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
